_doc: CAPTIONS FOR EVERY SOUND (W-G2, his call 2026-09-20: option b — name every sound, always). One line per sound the piece makes that is not already words on screen (the tapes carry their own captions; L's, Lamby's and Lambient's lines are on screen; the members have no voice). Shown in the frame's caption strip for a moment when the sound starts — square brackets, frame voice, plain. Sounds not listed here show nothing; a sound listed here that is not registered plays nothing (tapeAudio.ts's registry law).
